name: Big Bar-Bar, War-Chief
bio: Bar-Bar Clan bugbear, an undefeated crowd favorite dropped in by Agent. Never retreats, but gets bored of targets out of reach or out of sight. Meant to be escaped, out-thought, or dueled, not beaten in a stand-up fight.

traits.name: The Long Reach
traits.desc: His melee reach is 20 feet. He carries the clan's oldest polearm, an absurd length of black-iron haft and hook that once belonged to the original Bar-Bar.

traits.name: Won't Stay Down (2/Day)
traits.desc: When reduced to 0 hit points by anything other than a critical hit or radiant damage, he drops to 1 hit point instead.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.desc: If he fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: Sweep (Recharge 5-6)
actions.desc: He swings the Long Reach in a full circle. Each creature of his choice within 20 feet makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. Fail: 22 (4d10) slashing damage and knocked prone. Success: half damage and not prone.

actions.name: BAR! BAR! (Bonus Action, 1/Day)
actions.desc: He roars the clan's name. Each Bar-Bar within 60 feet that can hear him gains 10 temporary hit points.

reactions.name: Can't Outrun Me
reactions.desc: When a creature within 20 feet of him moves, he makes one Long Reach attack against it. On a hit, the target's speed becomes 0 until the end of its turn.
